exposure.needed: which custom manifests or automation (e.g. label selectors, monitoring rules) select pods or external-listener Services by the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label

consequence.statement: Custom setups that rely on the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label stop matching pods and external-listener Services because that label is no longer set; the environment must switch to strimzi.io/pod-name.
consequence.remediation: Replace uses of the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label in custom setups with the strimzi.io/pod-name label.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external-listener Kubernetes Services, and custom setups leveraging that label should switch to the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label instead.
